description: Headroom runner: cheap search (random/SA/UCB1) at 32 evaluations vs a long SA to determine if an LLM has room to beat cheap methods on this task

rule.criterion: pass only if cheap_median - best >= k * max|J32 - J64|
rule.cheap_median: minimum over methods of the per-method median best J (temperature in C) across seeds
rule.best: the best J seen anywhere (long SA or any cheap run)
rule.note: Use the strongest cheap method's median, not the average, as the bar. All temperatures in C; lower is better.

long_sa.note: Each restart is a separate seed; total max evaluations = 4 * 1500 = 6000
